subject: Re: Kickoff: ArtVLM attribute recognition for catalog enrichment
body:
Status on eval, plus a risk.

VGARank-Attribute harness is live in Evalline. Prefix-LM scoring beats our contrastive baseline by 4.1 points mean average precision on attribute ranking; on VGARank-Object we're up 2.8. Csilla's ablation confirms most of the gain comes from modeling the object-attribute dependency directly rather than scoring them independently, consistent with the paper.

Risk: instance-level annotation density. Because VGARank annotates per bounding box, one image can contribute many instances, and our catalog images average far fewer boxes per image than Visual Genome. On a held-out catalog sample the transfer gap is ~7 points. Kaia is testing whether pseudo-labeling with the negative prompts ([obj, att, 0] entries) closes it.

More after next week's run.

Vera
